method.definition: Four-sentence proximity: positive NPMI over every distinct-word token-occurrence pair within a four-sentence radius; repeated mentions multiply the pair count
method.selection: global 99th percentile of eligible positive-NPMI scores, mutual top-eight neighbours, and one strongest fallback edge for each otherwise uncovered candidate word; no nominated-word retention

community_detection.scope: complete relation graph, including disconnected nodes

display_backbone.weight: relation score rounded to eight decimals
display_backbone.scope: opening display only; full links remain in payload

layout.algorithm: community-aware 3D spring with bridge refinement followed by deterministic component packing, graph-aware controlled overlap, and non-mutating opening-view selection

node_size.output: size_scale from 0 to 1 and render_radius from 0.65 to 2.15
